TeamWork.tasksSubtitle: Plan your work, share ownership, and track progress together.
TeamWork.noTasksHint: Create a task, assign a teammate, and choose a due date. Everyone on the team can create and update tasks; only the leader can delete them.
TeamWork.submissionSubtitle: Prepare your project with your crew and submit it before the deadline.
TeamWork.title: Project title
TeamWork.notOpen: The submission deadline has not been announced. You can save a draft; final submission will open once it is set.
TeamWork.deadlinePassed: The deadline has passed. Your saved project is now read-only.
TeamWork.leaderOnly: Only the current team leader can edit or submit this project. All teammates can view it here.
TeamWork.submissionHint: Final submission requires a title, summary, challenge, and an HTTP or HTTPS project page URL. You can update a submitted project until the deadline; saving changes keeps it submitted.
TeamWork.submitConfirm: Submit this project for your team? You can still edit it until the deadline.
TeamWork.draftSaved: Draft saved. It has not been submitted yet.
TeamWork.submissionSaved: Your project is submitted. Any saved changes are included.
TeamWork.incomplete: Add a title, summary, challenge, and project URL before submitting.
TeamWork.submissionConflict: Someone saved a newer version. Copy any changes you want to keep, then reload before saving again.
TeamWork.permissionChanged: Your team permissions have changed. Reload to see the latest project.
TeamWork.loadError: Could not load the project. Try reloading.
TeamWork.saveError: Could not confirm the save. Your edits are still here. Check your connection and use valid HTTP or HTTPS links.
TeamWork.reloadConfirm: Reload the saved project and discard your unsaved changes?
